pages.text: Sables establish caches beneath trees and defend them as personal property. Damaging or stealing from a wild cache provokes its owner.$(br2)They show a peculiar appreciation for smooth stones.

Offering a Smooth Stone causes a wild Sable to return a forest gift and carry the pebble to its cache. After four accepted pebbles, the giver of the fourth becomes its owner.$(br2)A tamed adult can be brushed for Sable Fur once per day. It follows when its owner carries Smooth Stone, and ordinary suitable meat can heal or breed it.
